editorial.overview: The official SnowPro Advanced: Data Scientist certification exam, certified and administered by Snowflake for data professionals, thoroughly covers many important data science concepts, essential Snowflake data science best practices, comprehensive data preparation and feature engineering, advanced machine learning models, and cutting-edge Generative AI and Large Language Model capabilities required for professional certification across modern enterprise data platforms today.

Practice writing Python and SQL pipelines for feature transformations and model training to ensure complete readiness for all tested topics on the examination day without missing crucial requirements.
